mentions.name: ChessNotate
mentions.description: A simple PGN app that captures chess notation from score sheets and fixes mistakes. It highlights errors while preserving the original moves, letting users verify whether a fix also corrects the remaining moves, unlike existing PGN parsers that stop at the first error and discard the rest.
mentions.problem: The author and his son often made mistakes writing chess notation (mixing up b and B, wrong ranks, missing moves), and existing PGN parsers stop at the first error and discard the rest.
mentions.audience: Chess players recording game notation, including the author and his son at a recent chess tournament
